audit_kind: Read-only requirement/source disposition; not new feature completion or a full regression run

requirements.requirement: Accessible names on buttons and inputs
requirements.implementation: The language pass names unnamed native control families while preserving explicit application names and native caption names.
requirements.remaining: The finite lint and custom-control receipts do not prove every possible runtime dialog/state or native reader usability.

requirements.requirement: High-contrast theme reachable from the GUI
requirements.implementation: HIGH_CONTRAST_PALETTE is selectable in Appearance; the Accessibility switch preserves/restores the prior theme.

requirements.requirement: Automated accessibility lint including item views, Home and Preferences
requirements.implementation: The registered-screen QAccessible lint and broader item-view/Home/eight-Preferences-tabs tests exist; derived names follow all nine locales plus English.
requirements.remaining: Tests were inspected, not rerun in this disposition; no fresh full-application or cross-platform acceptance claim.

requirements.requirement: Tab traversal and documented Accessibility controls
requirements.implementation: Text/table traversal, High contrast, mirrored text size, Reduce motion and shortcut-editor access have source and owning tests. Specific toggle/model-card/figure-grid/montage/clear repairs have separate receipts.
requirements.remaining: The strong-focus custom-control scope is tracked separately as N655.5.

requirements.requirement: Stronger focus outlines follow the requested width/color policy
requirements.implementation: Existing focus_ring_qss specifies a three-pixel contrast-checked ring for native button/input/item-view selectors. Custom figure/crop/clear controls paint fixed rings and do not consume strong_focus.
requirements.remaining: Coordinator approved a bounded actual-pixel before/after check and repair across these three owned controls. No failure is asserted until reproduced.

requirements.requirement: User guide, ten Accessibility captions and fifteen API arrivals
requirements.implementation: The guide Accessibility paragraph exists. The existing source-bound reconciliation records 90 caption/locale, 135 API/locale and 297 reviewed-block checks.
requirements.remaining: This is historical implementation evidence, not new translation work, a fresh catalog rebuild or native-speaker signoff.

requirements.requirement: Linux external accessibility bridge and reader-generated focus/help/state text
requirements.implementation: The integration receipt records actual external AT-SPI and Orca over 1415 nodes, with successful external focus/action/state and generated High contrast utterances.
requirements.remaining: That receipt is pinned to f7b35846aa, not a fresh replay of every current dependency. Audio was disabled; generated text is not audible delivery or human usability.

requirements.requirement: Audible screen-reader output and human usability
requirements.implementation: Previous isolated Orca checks intentionally disabled speech/braille output.
requirements.remaining: Requires explicit real-reader audible/user acceptance. No live desktop/audio or user preferences are changed by this audit.

requirements.requirement: Actual macOS and Windows accessibility behavior
requirements.implementation: The available source-bound native receipts are Linux-only.
requirements.remaining: Requires actual macOS/Windows GUI and accessibility-client checks. Offscreen Linux and inferred portability cannot close it.

requirements.requirement: Appearance tutorial refresh for the current Accessibility layout
requirements.implementation: The dated item notes assign Appearance tutorial recording to the Work session.
requirements.remaining: Work owns fresh recording, translations, publication and published acceptance. Home-B does not edit tutorial recordings or claim completion without its receipt.

limits: Historical WHAT IS LEFT bullets are interpreted with later dated notes, not treated as new unimplemented work.
